title: Reviewers sign in by key variable only
summary: Removes the login-file seeding path from the reviewer runner. `login_paths` disappears from the agent list and from `Reviewer`, along with `seed_login`, `real_home`, `copy_login`/`copy_dir` and the `run_one_noted` wrapper that carried the resulting notes. In its place a single `missing_credential` gate runs before any child is spawned: a reviewer whose `credential_env` is empty, or whose variables are all unset or empty, returns `could-not-run` with a reason naming the variable and never starts. `Attempt.notes` stays in the record but is now always empty. Tests and docs are updated to the new contract.

nodes.label: AGENTS list
nodes.subtitle: pub const AGENTS: &[Agent]
nodes.summary: Each agent entry no longer carries `login_paths`; the review facts are now name, family, command, hook wiring, session folders and `credential_env`. omp keeps an empty `credential_env`, which now means it can never start as a reviewer.

nodes.label: Review facts struct
nodes.subtitle: struct Review
nodes.summary: The `login_paths` field is gone. `credential_env` is documented as the only sign-in route: a reviewer starts with only these variables and does not start at all when none is set.

nodes.label: Reviewer
nodes.subtitle: struct Reviewer
nodes.summary: The runtime reviewer no longer holds `login_paths`; `from_agent` stops copying it. `credential_env` is the sole credential input.

nodes.label: missing_credential
nodes.subtitle: fn missing_credential(&Reviewer) -> Option<String>
nodes.summary: New gate. Returns a reason when `credential_env` is empty, or when none of its variables is set to a non-empty value. The reason names variables, never values.

nodes.label: run_with_retry
nodes.subtitle: fn run_with_retry(...) -> Outcome
nodes.summary: Calls `missing_credential` right after the read-only check and returns `Outcome::CouldNotRun` before any child is spawned. The `real_home` and `notes` parameters are gone.

nodes.label: run_one
nodes.subtitle: pub fn run_one(...) -> Outcome
nodes.summary: Now the only entry point: it delegates straight to `run_with_retry`. The `run_one_noted` wrapper that returned notes alongside the outcome is removed.

nodes.label: prepare_command
nodes.subtitle: fn prepare_command(...) -> Result<(Command, RunHome), String>
nodes.summary: Creates the fresh `RunHome` and builds the cleared-environment command. The key-in-environment branch and the `seed_login` call are gone, so the home is always empty and no login file is ever copied.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: fn run_child(...) -> Result<String, Failure>
nodes.summary: Spawns the harness with the prepared command. The `real_home` and `notes` parameters are dropped; the doc comment now states the home is empty and no login file is ever copied.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: struct RunHome
nodes.summary: The temporary home directory applied to the child's environment and removed on drop. Unchanged; it is now simply never seeded.

nodes.label: seed_login / copy_login
nodes.subtitle: fn seed_login, real_home, copy_login, copy_dir
nodes.summary: The whole login-copying machinery is deleted: path validation, home lookup, recursive copy and the notes it produced.

nodes.label: Attempts::record
nodes.subtitle: impl Attempts
nodes.summary: Calls `reviewers::run_one` instead of `run_one_noted` and stores an empty `notes` vector on every attempt.

nodes.label: Attempt
nodes.subtitle: struct Attempt
nodes.summary: The `notes` field stays in the saved record but its doc no longer mentions login paths; it is empty for a run that noted nothing.

nodes.label: reviewers unit tests
nodes.subtitle: mod tests
nodes.summary: Login-copy tests are replaced by tests that every reviewing agent refuses to start without its key variable, that an empty variable counts as unset, and that no agent's reviewer home holds a login file even when the real home is unreadable.

nodes.label: review_run integration tests
nodes.subtitle: tests/review_run.rs
nodes.summary: The fake harness environment now injects a dummy value for every agent's credential variable, so reviewers start under the new gate.

nodes.label: reviewers integration tests
nodes.subtitle: tests/reviewers.rs
nodes.summary: The fake reviewer declares `OSF_FAKE_REVIEWER_KEY` and sets it once, since a reviewer with no credential variable no longer starts.

nodes.label: Decisions 0016 / 0020
nodes.subtitle: docs/architecture/decisions
nodes.summary: Both records now state that osf never copies a login file and that a reviewer without its key variable does not start.

nodes.label: development.md
nodes.subtitle: docs/development.md
nodes.summary: Documents the key-variable-only sign-in and adds a per-agent table of key variable and could-not-run behaviour.

Each attempt is written with result, reason and empty notes.
New tests assert the gate's reason text and that the harness never starts.
Tests drive `run_one` across every reviewing agent against a fake real home.
The fake harness supplies dummy key variables so reviewers start.
The fake reviewer now declares a credential variable.
